sections.title: 一、阅读理解 A
sections.instruction: 阅读下列短文，从每题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Coming up:

# UNEXPECTED INVENTIONS
# Exhibition!

Learn about great inventions and their inventiors

DON'T MISS OUT!

| Item | Information |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Time** | 1 May - 30 May, 9 am - 5 pm |
| **Place** | City Museum |
| **Tickets** | |
| Adults | £30 |
| Students | £15 |
| Children under 12 | Free |


**Special event**
A talk by Mary Brown. You can learn all about the qualities of a successful inventor.lt starts at 10:30 am on 1 May.

PS: You can get an extra 20% off if you go in a group of 10 or more.

questions.prompt: The exhibition is in ________.
questions.translation: 这次展览在哪里？
questions.explanation: 根据表格中的“Place: City Museum”可知，展览在城市博物馆举行。故选 a museum。

questions.prompt: A teacher will take 10 students of 15 to the exhibition, it will cost ________ in all.
questions.translation: 一位老师将带15岁的10名学生去参观展览，总共需要花费多少钱？
questions.explanation: 学生票价为每人 £15，10名学生总价为 10 × 15 = £150。老师作为成人，票价为 £30，总价原为 150 + 30 = £180。由于团购人数达到10人或以上（1位老师 + 10名学生 = 11人），可以享受额外的20%折扣（即总价打8折），180 × 0.8 = £144。故选 144 pounds。

questions.prompt: The special event is about ________.
questions.translation: 特别活动是关于什么的？
questions.explanation: 根据“A talk by Mary Brown. You can learn all about the qualities of a successful inventor.”可知，特别活动是关于成功发明人的特质。故选 qualities of a successful inventor。

questions.prompt: The text is ________.
questions.translation: 这篇文本是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据文本内容是一份关于发明展览的时间、地点、票价及特惠信息的宣传单可知，这是一则广告。故选 an advertisement。

sections.title: 二、阅读理解 B
sections.instruction: 阅读下列短文，从每题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
I am an English teacher.I really don't like that class "Talk about your family". The students say, "There are five people in my family. My mother, my father..."It sounds like that all families are the same.

Our families are one and only. All have their stories, jokes and so on. They're the place where our personalities were made.

We know our families so well that we even think they're boring.Not at all.Families are the most special things.If you dig enough into your own, you will get everything for a great book.

My mother started making our family tree years ago, not expecting to get far. However, reading the old records and visiting libraries, she got back 300 years.She found some old stories. What happened to the big family farm? Where did the family fortune (财富) go in the 1870s?

I'm the traveler in my family, and I love travelling.I always think I got <u>it</u> from a great grandfather.My two favorite family heirlooms (传家宝) are a photo of him on a horse and a postcard from China.If you look at your family, you open a window to the past.

When my mother, still putting the family tree together, asked me for a few names from my Russian wife's family, my wife got on the phone to check a name or two. But she spent an hour talking with her mother. So you can see that some people start talking about their family stories and they might never stop exploring.

To go back to that English class, let's look at some interesting ways to talk about families.English is rich in idioms(习语) to talk about family life. The black sheep of the family is someone who brings family trouble.If you're true to your family, you can say "blood is thicker than water"."Who wears the trousers in your family?" means "Who's the head of your family? "And stories behind them are what I want to hear.

questions.prompt: What does the writer think of the class "Talk about your family" at first?
questions.translation: 作者起初对“谈论你的家庭”这节课有什么看法？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“I really don't like that class... It sounds like that all families are the same.”可知，作者起初觉得千篇一律很无聊。故选 Boring。

questions.prompt: What does "<u>it</u>" refer to in paragraph 5?
questions.translation: 第5段中的“<u>it</u>”指代什么？
questions.explanation: 根据上文“I'm the traveler in my family, and I love travelling.I always think I got <u>it</u> from a great grandfather.”可知，it指代前文提到的对旅游的热爱。故选 His love for travelling。

questions.prompt: What can we learn from the passage?
options: The writer doesn't really like his teaching job in Russia.
The writer wants to make a great book for his family.
The writer's mother visited libraries to get the family heirlooms.
The writer's wife is very interested in the family stories.
questions.translation: 我们能从文章中了解到什么？
questions.explanation: 根据倒数第二段“...my wife got on the phone to check a name or two. But she spent an hour talking with her mother. So you can see that some people start talking about their family stories and they might never stop exploring.”可知，作者的妻子对家庭故事非常感兴趣。故选 The writer's wife is very interested in the family stories。

questions.prompt: Amy decides almost everything in the family, so which of the following can describe her?
options: She is the dark horse of the family.
She is the black sheep of the family.
She wears the trousers in the family.
Her blood is thicker than water.
questions.translation: 艾米决定家里几乎所有的事情，所以以下哪项可以描述她？
questions.explanation: 根据文末习语“"Who wears the trousers in your family?" means "Who's the head of your family?"”可知，掌权、作决定的人可用“wears the trousers”来形容。故选 She wears the trousers in the family。

sections.title: 三、阅读理解 C
sections.instruction: 阅读下列短文，从每题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Yunjin is a beautiful brocade(锦缎) made in Nanjing, Jiangsu Province. Yun in Chinese means clouds and jin means brocade. The materials used in yunjin are valuable, such as silk, gold and silver, resulting in its high collecting value.

Yunjin, with a history of over 1, 600 years, has the best quality among all the brocades in China.lt stands for the finest Chinese silk cloth. The brocade comes out from a traditional wooden loom (织布机) as big as 5.6 meters long, 1.4 meters wide and 4 meters high. The huge loom needs two people to work, one above and one below. The process(过程) is so long and difficult that a brocade with a length of 5 to 6 centimeters takes two people all day to make and the production cannot be replaced with modern machines.

Its pictures are large in shape and the use of gold and silver makes them rich and shining.In ancient times, yunjin served as materials for royal family's clothes and to beautify their palaces.It was also used as gifts for important foreign guests.

With the development of technology and changes in people's lifestyle, young people have less interest in traditional arts which require a long time of learning and practicing. To pass down the skills of yunjin, the Chinese government set up Nanjing Yunjin Research Institute in 1957, which has helped spread the culture of brocade and built a cultural bridge between China and the world.

questions.prompt: Why does yunjin has a high collecting value?
options: Because it has a long history.
Because it has the best quality.
Because it is made of valuable materials.
Because it is made by huge wooden looms.
questions.translation: 为什么云锦具有很高的收藏价值？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“The materials used in yunjin are valuable, such as silk, gold and silver, resulting in its high collecting value.”可知，云锦使用昂贵的材料，因此具有很高的收藏价值。故选 Because it is made of valuable materials。

questions.prompt: The Chinese government set up Nanjing Yunjin Research Institute to ________.
options: pass down the skills of yunjin
questions.translation: 中国政府成立南京云锦研究所是为了……
questions.explanation: 根据最后一段“To pass down the skills of yunjin, the Chinese government set up Nanjing Yunjin Research Institute in 1957...”可知，成立研究所是为了传承云锦的技艺。故选 pass down the skills of yunjin。

questions.prompt: What do you learn about yunjin from the passage?
options: It takes 5 to 6 days to make.
It interests more people to learn it.
It has large, rich and shining pictures.
It can be made by modern machines.
questions.translation: 从文章中你能了解到关于云锦的什么信息？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“Its pictures are large in shape and the use of gold and silver makes them rich and shining.”可知，云锦的图案很大，使用金银使其显得丰富而闪亮。故选 It has large, rich and shining pictures。

questions.prompt: Which can be the best title for the passage?
options: The First Invention in Chinese History.
The Biggest Change in Chinese History.
The Latest Material of Chinese Silk Cloth.
The Greatest Symbol of Chinese Silk Cloth.
questions.translation: 以下哪个可以作为文章的最佳标题？
questions.explanation: 通读全文可知，文章主要介绍了拥有悠久历史、顶级品质及珍贵价值的中国丝绸织品代表——云锦。故选 The Greatest Symbol of Chinese Silk Cloth。

sections.title: 四、阅读理解 D
sections.instruction: 阅读下列短文，从每题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
# The Amazing Discovery of Plant Communication

A recent study from the Chinese Academy of Sciences (中科院) has found a wonderful secret of the natural world; trees in a forest can actually "talk" to each other and work together to help each other stay healthy and grow.This discovery is changing our understanding of forests, showing they are far more than just many trees growing in one place.

The study explains that trees are connected by a special web under the ground. This web is made of their roots and a kind of fungi (真菌) which acts like a natural internet, often called the "Wood Wide Web". When a tree is attacked by insects or is short of water, it doesn't stay in silence.Instead, it sends out special messages to tell other trees about the danger through this web.Nearby trees that receive these messages will quickly start making special things to protect themselves.

What's more, the help doesn't stop there.In the forest, there are larger, older trees, called "mother trees", which play an important role. They are often the most connected centre in the web and will even share valuable nutrients (营养素) and water with younger trees through their roots and the fungi, giving them a better chance to grow better.

This exciting discovery teaches us a very important lesson about nature.lt helps us understand why it's important to protect whole forest ecosystems, not just focusing on single trees. When we cut down too many trees, we break their communication and support webs. Then, they cannot help each other when there is a big storm, a tree sickness, or other problems like climate change. Life becomes much harder for them.

The research team leader, Dr.Wang, shared his thoughts on the bigger lesson: "This teaches us a beautiful lesson about working together and community.Just like trees that support each other unconditionally, we humans should also work together to protect our environment.Every tree matters in a forest, just as every person matters in our society." This finding reminds us that we are part of an interconnected world, and our future depends on learning from the wisdom of nature.

questions.prompt: How do trees mainly "talk" to each other according to the study?
options: By sending messages through the air.
By changing the color of their leaves.
Through their roots and a special web under the ground.
questions.translation: 根据研究，树木主要通过什么方式互相“交谈”？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“The study explains that trees are connected by a special web under the ground. This web is made of their roots and a kind of fungi...”可知，树木通过根部和地下的特殊网络进行交流。故选 Through their roots and a special web under the ground。

questions.prompt: What do "mother trees" do to help younger trees?
questions.translation: “母树”做些什么来帮助幼小的树木？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“...will even share valuable nutrients (营养素) and water with younger trees through their roots and the fungi...”可知，母树通过根部和真菌与幼树分享营养。故选 Share nutrients through their roots。

questions.prompt: What does Dr.Wang mainly want to tell us?
options: Cutting down trees is important for making cities bigger.
Humans should learn from trees and work together.
Older people are always wiser than young people.
Trees are as important as people.
questions.translation: 王博士主要想告诉我们什么？
questions.explanation: 根据最后一段“Just like trees that support each other unconditionally, we humans should also work together to protect our environment.”可知，人类应该像树木一样团结协作。故选 Humans should learn from trees and work together。

questions.prompt: Which of the following best describes the purpose of the passage?
options: To explain how fungi help trees grow.
To describe the dangers forests are facing.
To tell us about a scientific discovery and its lesson on working together.
To encourage people to protect plants.
questions.translation: 以下哪项最能描述本文的写作目的？
questions.explanation: 通读全文可知，文章介绍了树木交流这一科学发现，并借此探讨了人与自然共同协作的道理。故选 To tell us about a scientific discovery and its lesson on working together。

sections.title: 五、阅读还原
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从方框内所给的选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项，其中有一个多余的选项。
sections.passage:
Living in a messy home is not enjoyable.It can make you feel worried, because you always have trouble finding things and the mess might even make you feel bad. However, a clean and tidy home can make your life more comfortable. [1] ________

One way to start tidying up your home is to make a cleaning plan. [2] ________ For example, one person can sweep the floor, another can clean the bathroom, and someone else can tidy up the living room. When you make plans and work together, you can make the cleaning faster and easier. [3] ________ Put all your things together and think about what you don't need or use. You can give these things to people who need them, like giving old clothes to those in need or giving books to libraries. You can create more space and keep your home in order after you give away things you don't need anymore.

Lastly, make sure to put things back in the right place after using them. This will help keep everything sorted. [4] ________ If you follow these ways, you can keep your home clean and tidy.

How can you sweep the world if you don't sweep one house? Doing housework is an important part of the all-round development of students.Doing chores also helps to develop students' independence and teaches students how to look after themselves, preparing them well for future life.
wordbank: Of course you cannot do it by yourself.
Another helpful way is to make it a habit to clean and tidy your home.
You can ask different family members to do different things.
Here are some useful ideas for tidying up your home.
And it is easier for you to find things when you need them.

questions.translation: 然而，一个干净整洁的家可以让你的生活更加舒适。[1] ________
questions.explanation: 上文提到整洁的家能让生活更舒适，引出下文介绍整理房间的有用方法。故选 D（Here are some useful ideas for tidying up your home.）。

questions.translation: 整理家里的一个方法是制定清洁计划。[2] ________
questions.explanation: 下文举例说明“一个人扫地，另一个人打扫浴室”，可知此处是建议让不同的家庭成员做不同的事。故选 C（You can ask different family members to do different things.）。

questions.translation: 当你制定计划并一起努力时，你可以使打扫更快更容易。[3] ________
questions.explanation: 承上启下，前文提到做家务需要合作，选项A指出“当然你不能独自完成它”，呼应合作的主题。故选 A（Of course you cannot do it by yourself.）。

questions.translation: 这有助于保持每样东西都有条不紊。[4] ________
questions.explanation: 前文提到用完后把东西放回原处，这带来的好处是更容易找到东西。故选 E（And it is easier for you to find things when you need them.）。

sections.title: 六、完形填空
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从每题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
For years I felt unhappy with the "bird's nest (窝) "on my head.My mother thought my hair was [1] (strange).However, my classmates didn't agree. They laughed at it, calling my hair the "bird's nest".

When I went to college, I decided to [2] (change) my hairstyle.I had my curly hair straightened (拉直). However, it cost me $ 500 every six months to do this. People said I was [3] (unwise) to spend that much.But for me, I would do anything to [4] (ever) again see that curly-haired girl in the mirror.

But when I had to start renting (租) my own flat, the [5] (cost) became too high.I had to be careful with money, so I began [6] (wonder) if I should carry on with my plan.I turned to the Internet for help.In the end, I found a "curly-haired" salon (沙龙) , a place designed for girls with strange hair.

When I arrived there, the stylist, Jacquai, was waiting for me.As my head was covered with a jelly-like jam, I asked, "Do you really think this will [7] (work)?"

"Sure. No curly hair is [8] (hopeless)." she replied. "You just haven't found a way to deal with it."

After an hour, Jacquai had finished her work. She had fixed my hair using only her hands. I couldn't believe it. My hair looked beautiful! Now my world has changed.I am more outgoing and [9] (cheerful) than ever. People say that I'm looking better and better, but they can't find out [10] (why) it has changed.I don't need to explain it.I know that my hair speaks for itself.

questions.translation: 我妈妈认为我的头发很[1]。
questions.explanation: 根据上下文，作者顶着“鸟窝头”，妈妈认为头发很奇怪。故选 strange。

questions.translation: 上大学时，我决定[2]我的发型。
questions.explanation: 后文提到把卷发拉直，说明作者决定改变发型。故选 change。

questions.translation: 人们说我花那么多钱是[3]的。
questions.explanation: 每半年花500美元拉直头发，在别人看来是不明智的。故选 unwise。

questions.translation: 但对我来说，我愿意做任何事来[4]在镜子里看到那个卷发女孩。
questions.explanation: 此处表达“曾经再次看到”，ever符合语境。故选 ever。

questions.translation: 但当我开始租自己的公寓时，[5]变得太高了。
questions.explanation: 上文提到每半年花费500美元，租房后开销变大，因此是成本太高。故选 cost。

questions.translation: 我必须精打细算，所以我开始[6]是否应该继续我的计划。
questions.explanation: 面临经济压力，作者开始琢磨/想知道是否该继续。故选 wondering。

questions.translation: 我问：“你真的认为这会[7]吗？”
questions.explanation: 这里指这个方法是否会起作用、奏效。故选 work。

questions.translation: “当然。没有哪种卷发是[8]的。”
questions.explanation: 造型师鼓励她，没有无可救药的卷发。故选 hopeless。

questions.translation: 我比以往任何时候都更加外向和[9]。
questions.explanation: 发型变漂亮后，心情变得开朗、快乐，cheerful与outgoing并列。故选 cheerful。

questions.translation: 人们说我看起来越来越好，但他们找不出[10]它发生了变化。
questions.explanation: 人们看不出头发是如何发生这种神奇改变的。故选 how。

sections.title: 七、语篇填空
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，在空白处填入适当的单词或括号内单词的正确形式。
sections.passage:
Albert Einstein once said, "I have no special talents.I am only passionately curious." The greatest inventions in history would be [1] (possible) without curiosity.

Curiosity can bring new discoveries. Benjamin Franklin is a great example. He was drawn to electricity and had a deep curiosity about [2] (it) nature. He did lots of research to try to understand it.For example, he flew a kite during a storm. His curiosity led him [3] (invent) the lightning rod. This invention protects buildings [4] (lightning).

Curiosity can also make people brave. Just look at Wan Hu, the Ming Dynasty pioneer of space [5] (explore).He was so curious about space that he invented a "flying chair"!He lost his life while testing this invention. Despite the failure, his curiosity gave future explorers [6] (idea).People learnt from his example, [7] (create) supported safer ways to explore space.

But curiosity is more than just taking risks.It also drives people towards certain goals.Zhang Heng, a Chinese scientist and inventor, was curious about the world: how did everything in the world move? He spent years studying the sky and the earth.Finally, he [8] (draw) China's first star map, and invented the [9] (one) earthquake detector.His curiosity continues to influence scientists today.

As Jacques Cousteau said, "What is a scientist after all? It is a curious man looking through a keyhole, [10] (keyhole) of nature, trying to know what's going on." Curiosity is the key.It opens one door after another for us to discover a new world.

questions.translation: 没有好奇心，历史上的伟大发明将是不可能的。
questions.explanation: 根据句意，没有好奇心，伟大的发明是不可能的。impossible意为“不可能的”。故选 impossible。

questions.translation: 他对电及其本质有着深深的好奇心。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词nature应用形容词性物主代词its。故选 its。

questions.translation: 他的好奇心促使他发明了避雷针。
questions.explanation: lead sb. to do sth.意为“促使某人做某事”，应用动词不定式。故选 to invent。

questions.translation: 这项发明保护建筑物免受雷击。
questions.explanation: protect ... from ...意为“保护……免受……”。故选 from。

questions.translation: 明代太空探索的先驱万户。
questions.explanation: space exploration意为“太空探索”。故选 exploration。

questions.translation: 他的好奇心给未来的探索者提供了思路。
questions.explanation: idea通常用复数形式表示“主意、思路”。故选 ideas。

questions.translation: 人们从他的榜样中学习，创造出更安全的太空探索方式。
questions.explanation: 此处用现在分词作结果状语。故选 creating。

questions.translation: 最后，他绘制了中国第一张星图。
questions.explanation: 描述过去发生的动作，应用一般过去时，draw的过去式为drew。故选 drew。

questions.translation: 并且发明了第一个地震仪。
questions.explanation: 表示“第一”应用序数词first。故选 first。

questions.translation: 通过一个钥匙孔，即大自然的钥匙孔……
questions.explanation: 后文有of短语限定，特指大自然的钥匙孔，应用定冠词the。故选 the。

sections.title: 八、任务型阅读
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，根据短文内容回答问题。
sections.passage:
A special event took place under the Oriental Pearl TV Tower in Shanghai on August 30, 2025.Claude Brouir, a 63-year-old man from Belgium, arrived after riding more than 12, 000 kilometers from Brussels on a solar tricycle (太阳能三轮车).People in Shanghai welcomed him warmly.

Brouir began his trip on April 19. For over 120 days, he rode across mountains, rivers and wide fields in Europe and Asia. His journey was not only for fun, and it was also a dream he had kept for a long time-to build a closer connection with China.

The idea started last November, when Brouir came to Shanghai to visit his eldest son, who now lives in the city. Brouir joined a cycling event and was touched by the kindness of local riders." That trip gave me the idea- why not ride all the way from Brussels to Shanghai? " he said.

To follow his idea of green travel, Brouir used a special solar tricycle.lt had two motors (发动机) and four solar panels (面板). The tricycle also pulled a trailer carrying his tent and daily things. With the help of the panels, he could climb hills without fuel. Along the way, he saw many beautiful places and often received help from strangers.

This year marks the 50th anniversary of China-EU relations (中欧建交50 周年) which makes his arrival even more meaningful.Brouir said the busy streets and friendly people of Shanghai made him feel at home. "Coming here is not the end, "he smiled, "It is a new beginning. "At the ceremony, officials praised his spirit. They said Shanghai would always welcome friends from Europe.

questions.prompt: How long did it take Claude Brouir to finish this trip?
options: It took him a whole year.
questions.translation: 克劳德·布鲁尔完成这次旅行花了多长时间？
questions.explanation: 根据文中“For over 120 days, he rode across mountains... ”可知，他骑行了120多天。故选 It took him over 120 days。

questions.prompt: Why did Claude Brouir take this trip?
options: Only to make money and become famous.
To build a closer connection with China and fulfill his long-time dream.
Just to test his new solar tricycle.
Because his son asked him to do so.
questions.translation: 克劳德·布鲁尔为什么要进行这次旅行？
questions.explanation: 根据文中“His journey was not only for fun, and it was also a dream he had kept for a long time-to build a closer connection with China.”可知，是为了与中国建立更紧密的联系并实现长期以来的梦想。故选 To build a closer connection with China and fulfill his long-time dream。

questions.prompt: How did Claude Brouir carry his tent and daily things during the trip?
options: He carried them on his back.
He put them in a backpack.
His tricycle pulled a trailer carrying them.
He sent them by express mail.
